subject: MorphOS Version RTF_EXTENDED resident revision ABI

observations: Resident.rt_Revision is a UWORD immediately after rt_Init.
The SDK marks rt_Revision valid only when RTF_EXTENDED is set.

offsetDerivation.basis: The existing CopperSharp Amiga Resident.Size constant is 26. Under the MorphOS header's pack(2), rt_Revision follows the classic fields through rt_Init at byte offset 26.

sourceEvidence.behavior: When createresidentver fails, the source falls back to rt_Version and revision -1; for MorphOS only, it replaces that revision with rt_Revision when RTF_EXTENDED is set, then creates the default version strings.

candidateEvidence.behavior: The RES fallback reads rt_Revision at offset 26 only when rt_Flags bit 6 is set. Supplied vectors force version-text allocation failure to reach both the extended-revision fallback and parsed-IdString paths.

limits: This records the documented structure ABI and source branch; it does not prove that every installed MorphOS resident is extended.
The candidate HUNK fixture does not replace original MorphOS guest execution, resident lifecycle, or package admission evidence.
